thread:
maria: Quick debrief — ran hybrid-quant bridge canary (hosted int8+nf4 baseline vs hybrid-int4 fallback) on prod traffic shadow for 24h. Observed a subtle quality dip on the long-narrative summarization slice (~1.8% relative ROUGE-L drop) and a small bump in hallucination rate on entity-heavy prompts.
raj: latency tail improved ~12% p95 for hybrid-int4 path, p99 flat. good win for cost.
olivia: can you share the A/B buckets and sample sizes? which slices are triggering the regressions?
maria: A: baseline (int8+nf4) n=18.2k, B: hybrid-int4 n=18.4k. Slices filtered by: long-narrative (>512 tokens), entity-dense, legal-style.
 sven: any KV-cache mismatch or prefix churn that could explain the drop? those often bite long-form.
maria: checked KV-cache hit-rates — identical. But we see higher token-repetition on entity prompts in B. Example failures in thread below.
raj: did the quantization-aware token distribution change? maybe top-k mass shifted.
maria: small shift in top1/top5 prob mass for rare tokens. Quick snippet from eval harness: 
```
slice: long-narrative
metric: ROUGE-L
baseline: 0.412
hybrid-int4: 0.405
delta: -0.007 (~1.7%)
```

olivia: is this within our auto-fallback thresholds? recall rule: any ROUGE-L drop >1% on watch-slices triggers 10% rollback or auto-fallback.
maria: yes, it crosses the 1% absolute threshold for that slice and the lift is negative across multiple runs. Canary-bot: Canary policy check: FAILED — watch-slice ROUGE-L delta -0.017 (relative -4.12%). Auto-fallback: recommended.
sven: do we have a config knob to increase safety hysteresis for hybrid-int4 on long-context? maybe require 2 sequential failing windows before auto-fallback.
raj: we can switch routing: keep hybrid-int4 at 5% traffic with shadowing until we fix token-mass shift. That avoids full rollback but prevents user exposure.
olivia: next steps: (1) reduce B exposure to 5% via routing override, (2) run targeted local quantization sweep on entity-dense prompts to identify which weight ranges cause rare-token drift, (3) run a 48h quiet-burn shadow only for long-narrative slice.
maria: on it. I'll open a follow-up ticket with sample failures and quant diffs, and tag @sven and @raj. ETA for initial sweep: 24h.
sven: +1. If the quant sweep doesn't find a clear culprit, we should consider rolling forward with the baseline but enable the hybrid-int4 for short-context routes only.
raj: logging note — capture topk distribution snapshots during canary windows. add to canary trace.
maria: noted. will attach traces and the failure samples to ticket. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
